rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone is astonished or surprised.

example.english: They were genuinely astonished when they heard that they had won a prize.
example.traditional: 佢聽到自己攞獎，真係驚訝。
example.jyutping: keoi5 teng1 dou2 zi6 gei2 lo2 zoeng2 zan1 hai6 ging1 ngaa6

rows.note: Use this when the astonishment mainly comes from something being unexpected or unforeseen.

example.english: The result was so unexpected that we were astonished.
example.traditional: 個結果咁意外，我哋都睇到呆咗。
example.jyutping: go3 git3 gwo2 gam3 ji3 ngoi6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 tai2 dou2 daai1 zo2

rows.note: Use this for stronger astonishment that approaches being shocked or deeply disturbed.

example.english: They were astonished when he suddenly announced his resignation.
example.traditional: 佢突然宣布辭職，成班人都震驚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dat6 jin4 syun1 bou3 ci4 zik1 seng4 baan1 jan4 dou1 zan3 ging1
